page_title: JUV 2-0 VER | Juventus v Verona 03/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+3' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
90+1' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' 2 - 0 Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!
86' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Amin Sarr is replaced by Mathis Lambourde (Verona).
82' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Randal Kolo Muani.
82' Thiago Motta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) replacing Kenan Yildiz.
81' Matteo Marchetti blows the whistle, Antoine Bernede (Verona) is penalised for a foul.
79' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Tomas Suslov walks off the pitch to be replaced by Grigoris Kastanos (Verona).
76' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
72' 1 - 0 Goal! Khephren Thuram (Juventus) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Andrea Cambiaso, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
72' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
72' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
71' Today's match ends for Federico Gatti who will be replaced by Pierre Kalulu (Juventus).
68' 76:24 – the latest ball possession ratio.
65' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Verona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
63' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
61' Here is a change. Timothy Weah is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Alberto Costa (Juventus).
60' Substitution. Weston McKennie did his best and is replaced by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus).

60' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Lorenzo Montipo shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
58' Good chance! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
56' Paolo Zanetti has decided to substitute Dailon Rocha Livramento and he is replaced by Antoine Bernede (Verona).
56' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
55' The ball goes out for a corner. Juventus can continue in their attacking effort.
54' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
54' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
53' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) runs into space on the edge of the box and tries a curler that drifts well wide of the left post.

50' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
48' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) comes off for Daniele Ghilardi.
46' The game is over for Davide Faraoni. Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) comes on for the second half.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Verona due to an offside in the build-up play.
45+2' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Verona players aren’t happy.
45+2' Tomas Suslov (Verona) receives a precise pass and tries his luck with a shot from mid range. The ball glances off the crossbar and behind the surprised goalkeeper.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
42' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Lorenzo Montipo comes off the line to clear the ball away.
41' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) drills a low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads towards the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.

40' Lorenzo Montipo pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the middle of the goal, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
40' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Juventus.

40' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the roof of the net. However, Lorenzo Montipo anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
38' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Verona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
37' Goal disallowed! Weston McKennie (Juventus) scores but Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.

36' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
34' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
33' The resulting set piece from Juventus is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
33' Juventus have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
33' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
31' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle as Tomas Suslov (Verona) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
24' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but Lorenzo Montipo comes off his line to gather the ball.
24' A cross from a corner kick by Juventus is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
23' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
22' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar.
22' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Juventus.
20' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Juventus, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
19' Cheikh Niasse (Verona) brings his opponent down. Matteo Marchetti has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
17' A rebound sits up nicely for Federico Gatti (Juventus) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, balloons high over the bar and out for a goal kick.
15' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Matteo Marchetti has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
14' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

14' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Lorenzo Montipo anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
13' Federico Gatti (Juventus) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
12' Juventus couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
11' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
9' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
6' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
5' The shot by Cheikh Niasse (Verona) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Michele Di Gregorio.
2' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) jumps into a tackle and Matteo Marchetti signals a foul.
